summary: Tested all reported bug fixes and features: (1) Team page image upload with s3_url fix verified in code, (2) Multiple presenters selection in Show Management works correctly, (3) Calendar page presenters display working, (4) Show Detail page presenters display working, (5) Rundown Editor presenters display working
critical_code_review_comments: TeamSettingsPage.js line 401-405: Avatar image src correctly uses s3_url with fallback to local path, key prop added for re-render
ShowManagementPage.js: togglePresenter function correctly handles multiple presenter selection in default_presenter_ids array
CalendarPage.js lines 351-358: Presenters display correctly shows with Users icon when show.presenters has data
ShowDetailPage.js lines 727-750: Presenters section displays correctly with avatar and name
RundownEditor.js lines 334-356: Presenters display section added after header with correct styling

success_rate.backend: N/A - No API tests run (code review only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All presenter-related features are working: (1) Show Management allows selecting multiple presenters via popover dropdown, (2) Calendar sidebar shows presenters with Users icon, (3) Show Detail page shows Presenters section in Show Details and Rundown Editor, (4) Team Settings page avatar uses s3_url when available with key prop for re-render. Test shows: 'Backstage Radio' has presenter 'Yannick Gijbels' correctly displayed across all views.

Show Management - Multiple Presenters.details: Verified popover dropdown allows selecting multiple team members. Selected 'Yannick Gijbels' and 'Hadewig Weyen' successfully. togglePresenter function correctly adds/removes presenter IDs from default_presenter_ids array.

Calendar Page - Presenters Display.details: Calendar sidebar shows presenters with Users icon. 'Backstage Radio' show displays 'Yannick Gijbels' with Users icon in sidebar.

Show Detail Page - Presenters Display.details: Show Detail page shows 'Presenters:' section with avatar and name. 'Backstage Radio' shows 'Yannick Gijbels' presenter correctly.

Rundown Editor - Presenters Display.details: Rundown section shows 'Presenters:' after header with presenter name pills. 'Backstage Radio' rundown shows 'Yannick Gijbels' presenter.

Team Settings - Avatar Image Fix.details: Code review verified: img src uses 'member.avatar.s3_url' with fallback to local path. Key prop 'member.avatar.s3_url || member.avatar.file_key' added for forced re-render on avatar change.
